*   **White (W) cells:** $x_{ij}$ where $i+j$ is even. (e.g., $x_{11}, x_{13}, x_{22}, x_{24}, x_{31}, x_{33}, x_{42}, x_{44}$). There are 8 W-cells.

Condition 1: No two coins are orthogonally adjacent. This implies that if a W-cell has a coin, all its adjacent B-cells must be empty. Similarly, if a B-cell has a coin, all its adjacent W-cells must be empty. No two W-cells are adjacent, and no two B-cells are adjacent, so coins on cells of the same color never violate Condition 1 among themselves.
